content:
Whenever I type by in VS Code, the following thing pops up:

Since I usually want to insert a newline after by I hit enter.
Unfortunately, VS Code changes by to By as it thinks I want to select the suggested option.
It is very annoying.
Can it be turned off?
Set 'Editor: Word Based Suggestions' to 'off'. See also https://github.com/leanprover/vscode-lean4/blob/master/vscode-lean4/manual/manual.md#auto-completion

Thanks a lot!
I think that turning off "Accept Suggestion On Enter" will be sufficient for me.
